summary: GATX Corporation filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, reporting an Underwriting Agreement dated November 2, 2026 with BofA Securities, Citigroup Global Markets and Morgan Stanley as representatives, covering $300 million of 5.950% Senior Notes due 2036 issued under its Form S-3 shelf. Notes were delivered against payment on November 6, 2026, under a 2008 indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee. This is an ordinary investment-grade debt takedown creating a direct financial obligation, not a special situation; no equity, change-of-control or arb angle exists.
